statement: NVIDIA states it is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.
why: The vendor has removed China data-center compute from its forward plan entirely, so export-control exposure is being carried as zero contribution rather than as a risk-adjusted amount.

impact.mechanism: Excluding a whole geography from the demand plan removes that end market from the addressable revenue base while leaving upside if policy changes.

evidence.source: NVIDIA investor relations / newsroom press release
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.

confidence.basis: Primary vendor statement quoted verbatim from the results release.
